description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
When Woodfall Primus enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station, untapping it.
Resolve the Woodfall Primus trigger, destroying a noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
